caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a dress. The main section of the dress consists of a fitted black bodice with three-quarter sleeves, embellished with white and blue trim around the neckline, hem, and sleeve cuffs, which are further decorated with black lace. The skirt of the dress is long and flowing, rendered in a light blue color and printed with large swirling floral patterns outlined in darker blue; it also features blue feathery accents at several points along the hem and sides. Above the shoulders, there are additional blue trim details. To the right of the main dress is a lightly sketched, monochrome outline showing the back view of the same dress, which details the draping, the floral pattern, and the arrangement of fabric but without any coloring or shading. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color.
title: Dress
